subject: Future Tech
title: Autonomous Trucks
description: A short lesson to help you apply Autonomous Trucks.

hook.text: Trucks drive predictable highway routes, 24 hours a day, with no need for bathroom breaks.

buildup.text: Highway driving is simpler than city driving. No pedestrians, no cyclists, no intersections.

discovery.text: Aurora, Kodiak, and TuSimple are developing autonomous trucks.

twist.text: 3.5 million Americans drive trucks for a living.

climax.text: Economics are compelling: trucks run nonstop, halve delivery times, and cut fuel costs 10-15% with optimized driving.

punchline.text: Highways first, cities next. Freight leads the way.

quiz.question: Why might trucks go autonomous before passenger cars?
options: Trucks are bigger and easier to outfit with sensors
Highway driving has fewer edge cases than city driving
Truck drivers support the technology more
